component.name: Relic Launcher
component.summary: Unofficial desktop launcher for Vintage Story

description.p: Relic Launcher is an unofficial community desktop launcher for Vintage Story. It is not affiliated with Anego Studios.
Install and manage game versions, browse ModDB, handle mods and modpacks, sign in once, launch Vintage Story, and run a local dedicated server from one place.

The Flatpak build runs Relic and the game inside the sandbox. Game installs, saves, and launcher settings live under the app sandbox XDG directories, not your host Vintage Story folders unless you grant access through a file picker.
